messages:
Maya Chen: Quick check — GlacierBio accepted the preview invite and wants to enroll 6 power users, but their finance lead asked for a seat reconciliation before enablement. Can someone confirm seat provisioning and whether we can run the enablement next week? https://redwood.ai/preview/glacierbio-onboard :wave:

Raj Patel: I can provision the seats. Do we have the user emails? If you drop them here I’ll add them to the preview group and share invites. :+1:

Tomás Ortiz: I chatted with their CTO earlier — Tue/Wed afternoons PST are best. They also asked about data retention & audit logs (privacy/regulatory). Flag: they said if enablement slips >2 weeks they may push timeline to next quarter (renewal risk).

Elaine Wright: I’ll lead the enablement once seats are live. Can someone capture their top 3 success criteria so the session isn't generic? Also want one or two sample prompts to demonstrate latency/quality tradeoffs.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist for preview cohorts — complete seat provisioning, invite, success criteria, enablement slides, post-session survey. Checklist: https://redwood.ai/onboarding/checklists/preview (auto-reminder in 48h) :spiral_calendar:

Raj Patel: Seats added — invited the 6 emails below and set role=power_user. Pulled from the spreadsheet Maya pasted earlier.
```
alice@glacierbio.com
brian@glacierbio.com
charlene@glacierbio.com
dev@glacierbio.com
ops@glacierbio.com
analytics@glacierbio.com
```

Maya Chen: Thanks Raj. Elaine — their initial success criteria (from discovery): 1) embed search relevance stable vs baseline, 2) <200ms mean latency on 95th percentile for short prompts, 3) safe filtering for patient PII. Also ask them for 3 gold prompts we can use for a quick eval.

Tomás Ortiz: I’ll draft a tiny eval set in the eval repo and tag @Elaine and @Jing to review. Plan to run baseline today and share numbers in the thread. I’ll also add a short checklist of compliance notes they asked about.

Jing Zhao: I can join the enablement to cover roadmap and ROI examples. Elaine — can you do Tue 2:00pm PST? If so I’ll block 30m for PM intro + 45m workshop.

Elaine Wright: Tue 2:00pm PST works. I’ll create the calendar invite and include a short agenda + post-session survey link. Who will own the survey results and follow-ups?

Maya Chen: I'll own post-session feedback capture & follow-ups. Please add a short NPS + two task-based questions. Put results in the beta-feedback board (Jira link: https://redwood.ai/jira/boards/BETA-FB). If anything looks off on the eval (latency drop or quality regression) tag me and add label "renewal-risk".

Raj Patel: Calendar invite sent to customer and internal leads. Seats confirmed.

Tomás Ortiz: Baseline run complete — 95p latency ~180ms, embed relevance delta -0.02 vs prod baseline (more notes to follow in eval PR). Posting the PR in #eng-ml after I clean it up.

Maya Chen: Great. Closing loop here — Elaine, please drop the session recording + short survey in the customer thread after the call. We’ll regroup in this thread for the post-session action items. :eyes:
